snippet.title: Infected Mushroom Pinball
snippet.description:
Infected Mushroom Pinball hits PC in July 2025, complete with native support for VR and VPIN setups.

Play, win concert tickets and discover how deep the rabbit hole goes.

WISHLIST NOW!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699650/Infected_Mushroom_Pinball/
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/infected-mushroom-pinball-5d5e4b

Learn more: https://www.infectedpinball.com

Trailer footage captured in-game and in real time, featuring both gameplay and cinematic scenes.

Join the Army of Mushroom http://linktr.ee/infectedmushroom

#InfectedMushroom #Psytrance #Psychedelic #Pinball #VR

Infected Mushroom is an electronic music duo known for their innovative blend of psychedelic trance, progressive rock, and experimental sounds. Explore their music, live shows, videos, shorts, and visual world - a genre-defying journey that continues to push the boundaries of electronic music.
